BETA Close X Serco Group PLC has purchased a total of 510,969 ordinary shares on March 30th and 31st, 2026, as part of its share buyback program. The average price paid per share was approximately 286.78 pence, with the lowest price at 284.20 pence and the highest at 290.20 pence. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 998,645,698, with 4,100,316 shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights, excluding treasury shares, is now 998,645,698. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 31 March 2026 31 March 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares and Total Voting Rights Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 4,100,316 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 31 March 2026 is 998,645,698 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 5 March 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 4,100,316 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
